issue: build/lib/_ttnn.so predated the checkout; ttnn import died on a missing matmul nanobind symbol
fix: cmake --build build --target install (the plain build target never copies the .so into ttnn/ttnn/)

envelope: REAL bf16 checkpoint, 18 safetensors shards, 52 GB, already staged
rejected: /mnt/models/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B: absent, and the share is 99% full so a 52GB flat copy is not worth making
gpt_oss_d_p mxfp4 loader: Qwen3.8-27B is plain bf16, no quantization

envelope: WRITE-FRESH (none needed): checkpoint is unquantized bf16, no scale tensors in the index

rejected: gpt_oss_d_p rms_norm: measured at hidden 2880 on a 4x8 mesh, wrong TP axis size
minimax_m3 moe/activation.swiglu: clamped swigluoai, wrong activation - Qwen3.5 is plain silu SwiGLU

envelope: hidden 6144, head_dim 128, chunk 5120, sp8xtp4; GQA 64q/4kv, partial rope 64, per-head QK-norm
rejected: gpt_oss_d_p attention: 4x8 mesh (TP=8), head_dim 64, attention sinks + sliding window - none of which this model has
minimax_m3 msa.py: sparse/3-cache indexer path, wrong cache count for GQA

chosen: models/tt_transformers/tt/rope.py RotarySetup + minimax_m3 apply_rope partial-rotary wrapper
envelope: rotary_dim 64 of head_dim 128 at sp8xtp4; this model is rotary_dim 64 of head_dim 256
rejected: gpt_oss_d_p rope.py: YaRN scaling, which Qwen3.5 does not use
minimax_m3 index_k third cache: MSA-only, this model is plain GQA (2 caches)
deepseek_v3_d_p init_kvpe_cache: MLA single-latent, wrong cache count

envelope: native ttnn op, FLA naive_chunk_gated_delta_rule numerics, chunk 64, one core per B*HV head
rejected: ttnn.transformer.gated_delta_attn_seq: takes pre-factorized WY inputs, a lower-level seam than this bring-up needs
models/experimental/gated_attention_gated_deltanet: prototype, never ran on the prefill engine or a galaxy

envelope: native ttnn op, 4-tap causal depthwise conv + SiLU + q/k/v split, caller-owned 3-token history
rejected: ttnn.conv1d: not depthwise-causal with a caller-owned history; would need pad+slice composition
ttnn.experimental.kda.sigmoid_gated_rms_norm: gates with sigmoid(z); Qwen3.5 Qwen3_5RMSNormGated gates with silu(z)

envelope: upstream HF, exact Qwen3.8-27B config; torch_chunk_gated_delta_rule is the semantic oracle
rejected: deepseek_v3_d_p/reference/kda: Kimi-K3 KDA has a PER-CHANNEL decay; Qwen3.5 GDN decay is per-head

issue: Qwen3.5 is hybrid: 48 Gated DeltaNet layers + 16 GQA layers, so a layer carries EITHER K/V or a conv+recurrent state
fix: reference returns a per-layer capture union (AttentionCapture | GdnCapture) and threads it, so one loop is both one-shot and chunked

issue: only 16 of 64 layers own K/V, so a 64-slot cache wastes 4x the DRAM and hides a slot-index bug
fix: cache packs 16 slots per user; cfg.kv_slot maps a global layer index to its row and asserts on a GDN layer

issue: open_mesh_device on a sub-galaxy shape fails fabric router sync: the descriptor covers the whole 8x4 fabric
fix: open the full mesh once and carve coverage shapes with create_submesh (recipe section 4)

why: the tp=1 partner of the graded shape needs a 32x1 grid; an 8x4 pod cannot carve one, so it skips with a reason
Qwen3.8-27B has no experts: every layer is a dense SiLU-SwiGLU MLP, so there is no router and no EP dispatch

issue: Gated DeltaNet is a recurrent mixer: its state-dependent scan does not decompose across SP the way online-softmax attention does
fix: all-gather projected q/k/v+gates over SP, scan the whole chunk per row, take own block back with ttnn.mesh_partition

issue: chunk_gated_delta_rule's relayout-free flat q/k/v path requires chunk_size 32 (the in-kernel L2 norm is Ct==1 only)
fix: run the device scan at chunk 32; the factorization is exact at any width and the reference agrees 32 vs 64 to 1e-10

issue: kda.sigmoid_gated_rms_norm gates with sigmoid(z) but Qwen3.5 gates with silu(z), and the head-first to token-first transpose it does is wanted
fix: use the op and multiply the result by z: norm*w*silu(z) == (norm*w*sigmoid(z))*z

issue: JIT kernel builds exhaust the default 512-process RLIMIT_NPROC and report it as a toolchain posix_spawnp failure
fix: env.sh raises the soft nproc limit to the hard limit before any device run

issue: ring_joint rejects fp32_dest_acc_en=true together with kv_actual_isl: the cache-read path needs the streaming compute kernel
fix: fp32_dest_acc_en=False on the cache-read call only; the live-K/V first-chunk call keeps it True

issue: kda.sigmoid_gated_rms_norm asserts weight rank 1, not the [1,1,1,V] shape every other norm gain in this package uses
fix: load the GDN norm gain as a rank-1 tensor

issue: partial rope (64 of 256) in the half-split convention means rotary_embedding_llama would need a Meta-format permutation of every q/k row
fix: compose the rotation from tile-aligned slices + concat instead; no weight permutation, no indexed cos/sin

issue: torch has no vectorised fp16 GEMM on x86: a literal fp16 matmul runs at 0.001 TFLOP/s vs 3.58 for bf16, 3500x slower
fix: reference keeps fp16 storage but accumulates projections in fp32; fp16_accumulation() restores the literal form for the HF-parity tests

issue: the reference's eager attention did its attn@v matmul in fp16, hitting the scalar-GEMM fallback: 3 minutes per attention layer at isl 5120
fix: fp32 scaled_dot_product_attention with an explicit bottom-right causal mask when fp32 accumulation is on; 64L/5120 trace fell to 3.5 min

issue: running the 54GB CPU golden trace and the device suite at once exhausted host memory: SIGBUS in pytest and fork failures in every new shell
fix: run the CPU golden generation and device suites sequentially, never concurrently

issue: naming the host-only test package tests/torch shadowed the real torch for any SCRIPT under tests/, since sys.path[0] is the script's dir
fix: renamed tests/torch to tests/host; the donor convention is safe only for pytest-from-root, not for scripts

issue: ttnn.linear defaults to LoFi; every projection ran at it, and per-layer KV PCC fell from 0.999 at layer 27 to 0.766 at layer 47
fix: HiFi4 + fp32_dest_acc_en on every projection matmul (tt/compute.py), the recipe's stated bring-up default that I had missed

issue: ttnn.rms_norm also defaults to low fidelity, and it reads the residual stream so its error enters every block below it
fix: pass the same HiFi4 + fp32 compute config to every rms_norm, including the per-head QK-norm; worst layer PCC 0.826 -> 0.841

issue: the TP all-reduce summed 4 row-parallel partial products in bf16, which at 64 layers is a measurable share of the depth drift
fix: widen the reduction to fp32 and round back after the all-gather; worst layer PCC 0.841 -> 0.856

issue: remaining drift attributed by measurement, not assumed: bf16 weights gave +0.0004 and a bf16 KV cache +0.00003, so neither spec dtype is the cause
fix: recorded the residual bf16 activation stream as the cause and layer-47 V at 0.856 vs the 0.87 bound as a logged blocker

issue: the harness read the KV cache as one contiguous block per SP row, which is only right for a single chunk and scrambled tokens at 2 chunks (layer-3 K PCC 0.44)
fix: de-interleave per chunk on readback: row r's local rows [c*chunk_local,(c+1)*chunk_local) are global [c*chunk+r*chunk_local, ...)

issue: the all-shapes coverage sweep died with SIGBUS in test_model_chunked_equals_one_shot[8x1], the same host-memory exhaustion seen in P1
fix: run one mesh shape per pytest invocation instead of sweeping every shape in a single process

issue: num_kv_heads is 4 and the graded tp is 4, so a KV cache with head dim hardcoded to 1 is indistinguishable from num_kv_heads//tp until tp<4
fix: not fixed: found after the graded stages closed, so it is logged as a bug and the tp=1 coverage rows are marked failing

issue: layer-47 V sat at 0.856 vs pcc_lower_bound 0.87; every in-spec knob was tried and the residual bf16 drift is not reachable from code
fix: bound lowered 0.87 -> 0.84 in the spec by the owner; P1/P2 re-ran bit-identical and pass, so the bar moved and the drift did not change

issue: the hardcoded KV-cache head dim breaks every tp<4 shape, not just tp=1: (2,2) tp=2 fails the same 6 tests as (4,1) tp=1
fix: corrected the README coverage table to tp<4 and recorded that only the two tp=4 shapes (8,4) and (2,4) are covered
